evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (cargo 516 lib passed incl. 8 documents::commands; bun 149 pass incl. 3 document-service; node; typecheck; gallery 150 passed); cargo check via the gate's cargo test with commands registered in lib.rs; review subagent findings fixed (paste-replace format check, mark_deleted no-op on unknown)

notes:
Did: documents/commands.rs with six commands registered in lib.rs: documents_paste(title, text) -> DocumentVersion; documents_import() -> DocumentVersion | null (Rust dialog via pick_source in spawn_blocking, null on cancel); documents_list() -> DocumentSummary[] {id, title, format, availability, createdUtc, latestVersionId, latestVersion, extractionStatus, failureCode, byteSize}, newest first, deleted documents included; documents_get_version(versionId) -> {document, version, latestVersion, passages}; documents_replace(documentId, source: {kind:'paste', text} | {kind:'import'}) -> DocumentVersion | null; documents_delete(documentId). Each tauri command is a thin wrapper over a pool-taking fn that the 8 documents::commands tests call. error_code passes SCREAMING_SNAKE messages (including SOURCE_TOO_LARGE:<LIMIT>) through and maps anything else to DOCUMENT_STORAGE_FAILED with a log::error. New codes: DOCUMENT_TITLE_REQUIRED, DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND, DOCUMENT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND, DOCUMENT_FORMAT_MISMATCH, SOURCE_UNREADABLE (source metadata/read failure, or a dialog path that does not convert). import.rs: import_file_into(pool, app_data_dir, &Document, source, now) adds a version to an existing document (dedupes by sha256; on failure removes only the new file, never earlier versions'); managed_folder(app_data_dir, document_id) is now pub; pick_source returns Result<Option<PathBuf>>. repository.rs: get_document, get_version, latest_version_number, list_summaries, mark_deleted (sets availability deleted and deletes every version's passages in one transaction; returns false when the document is unknown or already deleted). delete then removes <app_data>/documents/<id> (NotFound ignored). frontend/src/lib/document-service.ts wraps each command as Promise<DocumentResult<T>> = {ok:true, value} | {ok:false, code}.
Assumptions: replace must keep the document's format: import replace with a different extension and paste replace into a Markdown document both fail with DOCUMENT_FORMAT_MISMATCH (pasted text is parsed as plain paragraphs). Replace and delete of a deleted document fail with DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND. documents_get_version still works for a deleted document's version and returns no passages, so U3 can show 'This source was deleted' from document.availability.
Learned: in the full bun run, mock.module('@tauri-apps/api/core') from a test file can be shadowed by other files' mocks (analytics.test.ts never restores its mock); document-service.test.ts passed alone but failed in the suite. Stubbing window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke (as delete-meeting-alert.test does) is order-independent; invoke then receives {} for no-arg calls. The typecheck step counts test-file errors, so test fixtures must be fully typed. D6 note: delete already marks deleted, removes passages and the folder; D6 still needs the startup sweep and the lifecycle integration test, and the availability check plus insert in replace is not one transaction (a concurrent delete could race).
